title: Add linguistic_fingerprint and adaptive_verbosity columns to Companion and User models in chatbot/db/models.py
description:
Add columns for linguistic fingerprint (punctuation_habits, sentence_length_profile, emoji_style, vocabulary_density, slang_profile) to the Companion model and adaptive_verbosity to the User model. Make these columns nullable.

Before editing, inspect:
- chatbot/db/models.py
acceptance_criteria: Companion model has punctuation_habits, sentence_length_profile, emoji_style, vocabulary_density, and slang_profile nullable columns
User model has adaptive_verbosity nullable column
